query: Run Lighthouse across the https://www.facilitron.com/resources/guides section and find the pages with the worst performance.
expected_behavior: Picks the section URL as the target and selects the default section mode (audits only that section, not --page or --full)
Delegates the audit to the unlighthouse-runner subagent via the Task tool rather than assembling the npx command itself
Notes that the runner invokes the bundled deterministic scripts/site-audit.sh so the crawl stays scoped
Relays the runner's lowest-scoring pages plus the biggest-impact opportunities
